title: Neuroprotective Potential of Ethoxzolamide Targeting Oxidative Stress and Inflammation in Experimental Models of Intracerebral Hemorrhage.
authors: Li, Yongxia; Shen, Gang; Du, Jiarui; Dai, Wei; Su, Zuopeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究碳酸酐酶抑制剂ETZ在脑出血模型中的神经保护作用，涉及Keap1/Nrf2通路和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: As antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agents, carbonic anhydrase inhibitors can exert potentially useful therapeutic effects following central nervous system trauma, including intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). However, the therapeutic efficacy of ethoxyzolamide (ETZ) as a novel carbonic anhydrase inhibitor for ICH has not yet been determined. METHODS: An autologous blood injection method was used to establish ICH models, which were then used to establish the effects of intraperitoneal injection of ETZ on ICH. Neuronal damage, apoptotic protein expression, oxidative and inflammatory factor content, microglia marker Iba-1 positivity, hepatic and renal pathological changes, and serum concentrations of hepatic and renal function indices were assessed by Nissl staining, western blotting, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), immunohistochemistry, hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining, and automatic biochemical analysis in brain tissues. RESULTS: The ICH group showed massive hemorrhagic foci; significant increases in brain water content, modified mouse neurological deficit scoring (mNSS) score, pro-apoptotic protein expression, oxidative factors, pro-inflammatory factors, and Iba-1 positivity; and significant reductions in Nissl body size, anti-apoptotic protein expression, and antioxidant factors, all of which were reversed by ETZ in a dose-dependent manner. ETZ has a good biosafety profile with no significant burden on the human liver or kidneys. The Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1)/nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) pathway was mildly activated in ICH mice, and was further increased after ETZ injection. Molecular docking experiments revealed that ETZ could dock onto the Nrf2-binding domain of keap1. CONCLUSIONS: ETZ, as a novel carbonic anhydrase inhibitor, further activated the Keap1/Nrf2 pathway by docking with the Nrf2-binding domain of keap1, thereby exerting antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-apoptotic, and cerebral neuroprotective effects in ICH mice.
abstract_zh: 背景：作为抗氧化和抗炎剂，碳酸酐酶抑制剂在中枢神经系统创伤（包括脑出血（ICH））后可发挥潜在的有益治疗效果。然而，乙氧唑胺（ETZ）作为一种新型碳酸酐酶抑制剂对ICH的疗效尚未确定。方法：采用自体血注射法建立ICH模型，并以此评估腹腔注射ETZ对ICH的影响。通过尼氏染色、蛋白质印迹法、酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）、免疫组织化学、苏木精-伊红（HE）染色及自动生化分析仪，评估脑组织中的神经元损伤、凋亡蛋白表达、氧化和炎症因子含量、小胶质细胞标志物Iba-1阳性率、肝脏和肾脏病理变化，以及血清中肝肾功能指标浓度。结果：ICH组显示大量出血灶；脑含水量、改良小鼠神经功能缺损评分（mNSS）评分、促凋亡蛋白表达、氧化因子、促炎因子和Iba-1阳性率显著增加；尼氏体大小、抗凋亡蛋白表达和抗氧化因子显著减少，所有这些均被ETZ以剂量依赖性方式逆转。ETZ具有良好的生物安全性，对人肝脏或肾脏无明显负担。在ICH小鼠中，Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）/核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）通路轻度激活，并在ETZ注射后进一步增加。分子对接实验显示，ETZ可对接至keap1的Nrf2结合域。结论：ETZ作为一种新型碳酸酐酶抑制剂，通过与keap1的Nrf2结合域对接，进一步激活Keap1/Nrf2通路，从而在ICH小鼠中发挥抗氧化、抗炎、抗凋亡和脑神经保护作用。
